args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the gap between spot and contract pricing.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, making surcharge costs more volatile and closely tied to fuel-market movements.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least, per the companion piece — multi-carrier allocation is the cost-optimal strategy.
args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (Juniper Blog + Companion)
